# Automation reference

Generated inventory of the sync engine and mapped source files.

## Mappings

Every mapping states its generator's exactness and limits, so a reader can judge the output without reading the generator: `exact` is the authoritative record of what it reads, `heuristic` is a bounded extraction that can miss something of the kind it reports and warns by default (`generator.heuristic`).

| ID | Generator | Exactness | Limits | Sources | Target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| api | api | exact | Reads the route registry the server dispatches; a route handled outside it is not seen. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/routes.json | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/API-REFERENCE.md |
| config | config | exact | The declared configuration schema; a setting read without being declared there is not seen. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/config.schema.json | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/CONFIG-REFERENCE.md |
| env | env | exact | Derived from the same declared schema; an undeclared variable is not emitted. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/config.schema.json | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/.env.example |
| env-reference | environment_reference | exact | Described KEY=value entries; an undocumented key fails generation rather than being guessed at. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/.env.example | docs/reference/ENVIRONMENT.md |
| alerts | alert_catalog | exact | The declared alert file in the supported subset; other YAML expressions fail generation. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/monitoring/alerts.yaml, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/HEALTH-RUNBOOK.md | docs/operations/ALERT-CATALOG.md |
| example-dependencies | dependencies | exact | Declared requirements; resolved, inherited or vendored dependencies are not seen. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/pyproject.toml | docs/reference/EXAMPLE-DEPENDENCIES.md |
| data | sql | exact | The supported SQLite DDL subset; unsupported DDL fails generation rather than being guessed at. | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/db/schema.sql | EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/DATA-DICTIONARY.md |
| engine | automation | exact | The sync map and the files its own sources list; a script or mapping outside them is not listed. | scripts/doc-sync/*.py, scripts/doc-control/*.py, scripts/intelligence/*.py, scripts/validate/*.py, docs/.doc-sync-map.yaml | docs/generated/AUTOMATION-REFERENCE.md |
| catalog | catalog | exact | The three catalog indices as written. | CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-C/INDEX.yaml | docs/generated/CATALOG-REFERENCE.md |
| workflows | workflows | heuristic | Job names are read by pattern from the workflow text; a job declared inline, quoted or produced by a reusable workflow is not seen, and only the first jobs block is read. | .github/workflows/*.yml | docs/generated/WORKFLOW-REFERENCE.md |
| outline | outline | heuristic | ATX headings outside fenced code; setext headings, headings inside HTML blocks and included files are not expanded. | README.md, QUICK-START.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md, IMPLEMENTATION-GUIDE.md, docs/**/*.md, TEMPLATES/**/* | docs/META/OUTLINE.md |
| code-inventory | code_inventory | exact | Python declarations and first docstring lines from the interpreter parser; definitions created at runtime are invisible. | scripts/**/*.py, engine/**/*.py, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/src/*.py, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/web/*.js | docs/META/CODE-INVENTORY.md |
| test-inventory | test_inventory | exact | Tests discovered by AST; a test registered or generated at runtime is invisible. | tests/test_*.py | docs/META/TEST-INVENTORY.md |
| dependencies | dependencies | exact | Declared requirements; resolved, inherited or vendored dependencies are not seen. | pyproject.toml | docs/META/DEPENDENCIES.md |
| completeness | completeness | exact | Counts of catalog entries, templates and mapped targets. | CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml, TEMPLATES/**/*.md, docs/.doc-sync-map.yaml | docs/META/COMPLETENESS-REPORT.md |
| human-inventory | human_inventory | heuristic | Documents are discovered by the controlled path convention; a controlled document living outside those directories is not listed. | docs/**/*.md, CONTROL/**/*.md, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/*.md, CURRENT-STATE.md, NEXT-ACTION.md, RECENT-CHANGES.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENT-MEMORY.md, ANTI-PATTERNS-FOR-AGENT.md, CONTEXT-SNAPSHOT.md, TASK-FOR-AGENT.md, examples/ai-agent-example/docs/**/*.md, examples/local-tools-example/docs/*.md | docs/00-governance/INVENTORY.yaml |
| relationship-visualization | relationship_visualization | exact | Edges are declared facts from frontmatter, the sync map and catalog templates; the diagram is not a semantic analysis. | docs/.doc-sync-map.yaml, CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml, docs/**/*.md, CONTROL/**/*.md, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/*.md, CURRENT-STATE.md, NEXT-ACTION.md, RECENT-CHANGES.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENT-MEMORY.md, ANTI-PATTERNS-FOR-AGENT.md, CONTEXT-SNAPSHOT.md, TASK-FOR-AGENT.md, examples/ai-agent-example/docs/**/*.md, examples/local-tools-example/docs/*.md | docs/reference/DOC-RELATIONSHIPS.md |
| relationships | relationship_graph | exact | Links declared in frontmatter; a relationship nobody declared is not inferred. | docs/**/*.md, CONTROL/**/*.md, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/*.md, CURRENT-STATE.md, NEXT-ACTION.md, RECENT-CHANGES.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENT-MEMORY.md, ANTI-PATTERNS-FOR-AGENT.md, CONTEXT-SNAPSHOT.md, TASK-FOR-AGENT.md, examples/ai-agent-example/docs/**/*.md, examples/local-tools-example/docs/*.md | CONTROL/metadata/RELATIONSHIP-GRAPH.yaml |
| agent-tools | agent_tools | exact | The declared tool manifest, validated against the implementing function in the source tree. | examples/ai-agent-example/src/tools.json, examples/ai-agent-example/src/tools/*.py | examples/ai-agent-example/docs/AI/TOOL-INVENTORY.md |
| agent-prompts | agent_prompts | exact | File names, top-level headings and hashes of the mapped prompt files. | examples/ai-agent-example/src/prompts/*.md | examples/ai-agent-example/docs/AI/PROMPT-REGISTRY.md |
| agent-model | agent_model | exact | The declared model configuration as written. | examples/ai-agent-example/src/models.json | examples/ai-agent-example/docs/AI/MODEL-CONFIG.md |
| catalog-view-a | catalog_view | exact | The catalog indices as written; tiers and predicates are shown, not re-judged. | CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml | docs/01-catalogs/UNIVERSAL-DOCUMENT-CATALOG-A.md |
| catalog-view-b | catalog_view | exact | The catalog indices as written; tiers and predicates are shown, not re-judged. | CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml | docs/01-catalogs/UNIVERSAL-DOCUMENT-CATALOG-B.md |
| catalog-view-c | catalog_view | exact | The catalog indices as written; tiers and predicates are shown, not re-judged. | CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml | docs/01-catalogs/UNIVERSAL-DOCUMENT-CATALOG-C.md |
| catalog-navigation | catalog_navigation | exact | The same catalog data, grouped by view and domain. | CATALOG-A/INDEX.yaml, CATALOG-B/INDEX.yaml | docs/01-catalogs/CATALOG-INDEX.md |
| local-tool-reference | local_tool_reference | exact | The declared tool matrix; other YAML expressions fail generation. | examples/local-tools-example/config/tool-authorization.yaml | examples/local-tools-example/docs/TOOL-AUTHORIZATION.md |
| index | master_index | exact | Frontmatter fields of the controlled documents the same convention discovers. | docs/**/*.md, CONTROL/**/*.md, EXAMPLE-PROJECT/docs/*.md, CURRENT-STATE.md, NEXT-ACTION.md, RECENT-CHANGES.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENT-MEMORY.md, ANTI-PATTERNS-FOR-AGENT.md, CONTEXT-SNAPSHOT.md, TASK-FOR-AGENT.md, examples/ai-agent-example/docs/**/*.md, examples/local-tools-example/docs/*.md | CONTROL/metadata/MASTER-INDEX.json |
